usage: As a verb, 編輯 (pin1 kap1) refers to the action of modifying or arranging content, such as text, video, or audio.
As a noun, 編輯 (pin1 kap1) can also refer to an editor, the person who performs the editing.
The word 編輯 is commonly used in digital and print media contexts.
編輯 is often combined with specific content types, for example, 編輯文件 (edit a document) or 編輯影片 (edit a video).
編輯 can describe both the creative and the technical process of refining material.
